'''Andreas Weber''' (born 4 November 1967) is a German [[biologist]], [[Biosemiotics|biosemiotician]], philosopher and journalist.

== Biography ==
Andreas Weber studied biology and philosophy in Berlin, Freiburg, Hamburg and Paris. He became a PhD in philosophy in 2003 with the thesis ''Natur als Bedeutung. Versuch einer semiotischen Theorie des Lebendigen''. He has worked as a journalist for publications such as ''[[Die Zeit]]'', ''[[GEO (magazine)|GEO]]'', ''[[Merian (magazine)|Merian]]'' and ''[[Greenpeace Magazin]]''. He lives in Berlin and Italy with his wife and two children.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lebenslauf |url=http://www.autor-andreas-weber.de/vita.html |website=autor-andreas-weber.de |access-date=5 January 2023}}</ref>

In his monographs, such as ''Alles fühlt. Mensch, Natur und die Revolution der Lebenswissenschaften'' (2007), ''Biokapital. Die Versöhnung von Ökonomie, Natur und Menschlichkeit'' (2008) and ''Lebendigkeit. Eine erotische Ökologie'' (2015), he promotes concepts such as sensation, [[subjectivity]] and beauty as fundamental for interpreting the world.<ref>Michael Langer. 6 December 2015. [https://www.deutschlandfunk.de/musik-und-fragen-zur-person-der-biologe-und-philosoph.1782.de.html?dram:article_id=335908 Musik und Fragen zur Person – Der Biologe und Philosoph Andreas Weber]. [[Deutschlandfunk]]</ref>
